_comment: hand: weighted outcomes when investigated by hand. keys: item id -> guaranteed outcome when that item is used (the item is consumed). tags: whiskey / treasure / strange trigger quirk compulsions. {hero} in text is replaced by the investigating hero's name. Effects use the shared effect format (see scripts/core/effects.gd).

abandoned_wagon.name: Abandoned Wagon
abandoned_wagon.desc: A prairie schooner on its side, canvas flapping. Whoever owned it left in a hurry.

hand.text: {hero} finds a sack of flour and some tinned peaches.
{hero} pries loose a few good boards and some iron fittings.
A rattlesnake was nesting in the flour barrel!
Nothing but a child's rag doll. {hero} can't stop wondering what happened.

crowbar.text: {hero} pries open the locked sea chest under the seat. Silver coins, and a trinket wrapped in a handkerchief.

whiskey_barrel.name: Whiskey Barrel
whiskey_barrel.desc: A barrel of Taos Lightning, half-full and sloshing.

hand.text: {hero} takes a long pull. Liquid courage.
Rotgut. {hero} is sick as a dog.
{hero} fills a few bottles for later.
{hero} drinks... and keeps drinking.

crowbar.text: Under the false bottom: a smuggler's stash of coins and good bourbon.

old_grave.name: Lonely Grave
old_grave.desc: A wooden cross, the name worn away. Somebody piled stones on it to keep the wolves off.

hand.text: {hero} says a few words over the grave. The company feels a little lighter.
{hero} digs with their hands and finds nothing but bones and a cold feeling.
Buried with the dead: a pocket watch and some coins.

shovel.text: {hero} digs carefully and finds the settler was buried with their savings, and their luck.

salt.text: {hero} rings the grave with salt and says the old words. Something settles down to rest.

strongbox.name: Stagecoach Strongbox
strongbox.desc: Wells Fargo stenciled on the side. Still locked.

hand.text: {hero} bashes at the lock until it gives. Some banknotes inside.
The lock won't budge. {hero} bloodies their knuckles trying.
A spring-loaded blade! Somebody booby-trapped it.

crowbar.text: The lid pops open. Gold eagles and a mail pouch.

prairie_well.name: Prairie Well
prairie_well.desc: A stone well with a broken windlass. Something glints far below.

hand.text: The water is sweet and cold. Everyone drinks.
Alkali water. {hero} spends the next hour regretting it.
{hero} leans over too far and nearly falls in.

rope.text: {hero} lowers down on the rope and comes back up with a tin box someone hid in the well wall.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.desc: A scarecrow in a field nobody's farmed for years. It's facing you. It was facing the other way a minute ago.

hand.text: Just straw and a moth-eaten coat. There's a few coins in the pocket.
It turns its head. {hero} doesn't stop shaking for an hour.
Straw bursts out of it and it lurches forward. It wasn't a scarecrow!

salt.text: {hero} throws salt in its burlap face. Something leaves it with a sigh, and a warm charm falls from its sleeve.

berry_bushes.name: Chokecherry Thicket
berry_bushes.desc: Bushes heavy with dark berries along a dry creek.

hand.text: {hero} picks a hatful of berries.
Something else was eating here too. A snake bites {hero}!
Wrong berries. {hero} spends the night groaning.

antivenom.text: {hero} clears the snakes out properly and harvests the whole thicket.

cattle_skull.name: Bleached Cattle Skull
cattle_skull.desc: A longhorn skull on a post, painted with symbols no one in the company recognizes.

hand.text: {hero} studies the symbols and figures out it's a trail marker. It points to good water.
The empty eyes seem to follow {hero}. The whole company feels watched.
A warning sign. Someone was waiting for whoever touched it.

salt.text: {hero} sprinkles salt and the painted symbols fade. The land feels friendlier.

dead_horse.name: Dead Horse
dead_horse.desc: A saddled horse, dead a few days. The saddlebags are still buckled.

hand.text: {hero} goes through the saddlebags: jerky and a few coins.
The smell is unbelievable. {hero} gags the whole time.
The rider's wanted poster is in the bag. The rider's friends are nearby.

shovel.text: {hero} gives horse and rider a decent burial. In the rider's boot: a trinket.

standing_stone.name: Standing Stone
standing_stone.desc: A slab of rock twice a man's height, humming faintly. Much too big for anyone to have stood it up.

hand.text: {hero} puts a hand on it and feels... strength. Old strength.
The humming gets into {hero}'s teeth and won't leave.
{hero} is changed by the touch.

salt.text: A ring of salt quiets the stone. It gives up its old strength willingly.

miners_cache.name: Miner's Cache
miners_cache.desc: Crates and a pickaxe jammed into a crevice. Somebody meant to come back for these.

hand.text: {hero} finds candles, lamp oil and hardtack.
Iron tools and ore samples.
Old blasting powder goes off in {hero}'s face!

crowbar.text: The nailed crate holds a poke of gold dust and good tools.

bone_pile.name: Pile of Bones
bone_pile.desc: Animal bones, and some that aren't animal. Something drags its meals back here.

hand.text: Among the bones: a prospector's pouch of coins.
{hero} disturbs the pile and the stench of the den rolls out.
The owner of the bones comes home.

shovel.text: {hero} shovels through the pile quickly and safely. Coins and a strange trinket.

glowing_pool.name: Glowing Pool
glowing_pool.desc: A still pool that glows a soft blue-green. It's warm.

hand.text: {hero} splashes their face. Wounds close up.
The water burns! {hero} jerks back, blistered.
{hero} sees something in the reflection that isn't there.

salt.text: Salted, the pool stops glowing and becomes simple healing water.

antivenom.text: {hero} neutralizes the water with a tincture. It's safe to drink.

collapsed_tunnel.name: Collapsed Tunnel
collapsed_tunnel.desc: A side tunnel choked with rubble. There's a draft coming through.

hand.text: {hero} shifts enough rock to find an old lunch pail with coins inside.
Rocks shift and fall on {hero}.
Hours of digging for nothing.

shovel.text: {hero} digs through to a sealed pocket: a forgotten ore stash.

petroglyph_wall.name: Painted Canyon Wall
petroglyph_wall.desc: Faded paintings of enormous figures, with tiny people fleeing at their feet.

hand.text: {hero} studies the paintings and learns where the big ones walk, and how they fall.
The paintings are warnings. {hero} can't shake the dread.

salt.text: Offering salt at the wall, {hero} feels the land accept the company's passing.

railroad_crate.name: Railroad Supply Crate
railroad_crate.desc: Stenciled 'PROPERTY OF THE WESTERN TERRITORIES RAILROAD - NO TRESPASSING'.

hand.text: Spikes, fishplates and coal. The iron is useful.
The railroad sets alarms. Company men come running.
{hero} finds the payroll ledger. The company is swindling everyone.

crowbar.text: {hero} opens it quietly. Dynamite-proof lockbox inside: the payroll!

ore_vein.name: Ore Vein
ore_vein.desc: A streak of rust-red ore running through the rock. A little gold glitters in it.

hand.text: {hero} chips away with a knife and gets a few chunks.
A rock splinter catches {hero} in the eye.

shovel.text: With a proper tool {hero} digs out a real haul.

frozen_pack.name: Frozen Pack
frozen_pack.desc: A traveler's pack frozen into the ice, its owner nowhere to be seen.

hand.text: {hero} chips it out: frozen food, still good.
{hero}'s fingers go numb and white.
Inside: a letter to someone's family. {hero} takes it to deliver.

shovel.text: {hero} digs the whole pack out: food, a flask and a trinket.

cairn.name: Stone Cairn
cairn.desc: A pile of stones marking the trail. Tradition says you add one, and never take one.

hand.text: {hero} adds a stone. The company feels the trail welcome them.
{hero} takes a stone instead. Nothing happens. Probably.
There's a trapper's message hidden in the cairn: a map!

giant_bones.name: Giant's Bones
giant_bones.desc: A ribcage big enough to drive a wagon through, half buried in snow.

hand.text: {hero} finds weapons tangled in the ribs: the giant's last meal fought back.
Standing inside the ribs, {hero} really understands how small they are.

salt.text: {hero} honors the old giant. A marrow-stone falls from the bones: lucky, some say.

hot_spring.name: Hot Spring
hot_spring.desc: Steam rises from a pool in the snow. It smells of sulfur.

hand.text: Everyone takes a soak. Pure bliss.
Too hot! {hero} is scalded.
